description: Render a frame of the video you just wrote and LOOK at it. Shells the user's own Remotion CLI (`remotion still`) and returns the frame as an image. Call it after writing a composition and after every fix: a snapcn scene missing mode="dark" on a dark frame renders BLACK, and that is invisible from the code. Requires the user's Remotion project — snapcn does not bootstrap it.

composition.description: The <Composition id="..."> to render, exactly as registered in the Root file. Required: with no id the Remotion CLI opens an interactive picker and this call would hang.

entry.description: Remotion entry point, e.g. 'src/index.ts'. Omit unless the render says it cannot find one: the CLI already resolves remotion.config.ts, src/index.ts(x), remotion/index.ts(x) and src/remotion/index.ts(x) on its own.

frames.description: Frames to render, one image back per frame (max 4). Default [30] — 1s in, after the entrance. Pick the frame where each beat has LANDED; at frame 0 most snapcn components have not started and you will judge a blank. Negative counts from the end: -1 is the last frame.

project_dir.description: Root of the user's Remotion project — the folder with package.json and node_modules. Default: the directory this server was started in.

scale.description: Render scale. 0.5 of a 1280×720 composition is enough to judge layout, colour and a black frame. Raise to 1 only when you need to read small type.

timeout_seconds.description: Budget for the WHOLE call, all frames. The first render of a session also builds a webpack bundle and may download Chromium; later ones take seconds.

name: snapcn_preview
title: Preview a frame
